top_signals.title: FBI seeks truck drivers nationwide who may be victims in 54-count tax fraud case
top_signals.summary:
Most identified clients were self-employed truckers who found Genuine Financial Services through word-of-mouth referrals. Investigators believe additional customers may not know whether the company completed their filings or paid their taxes.
